description: On an uncountable type, the singleton false maps form an uncountable pairwise compatible family with no finite common extension; their graph union is the total constant-false graph.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.zero_singletons_specification.{u} {α : Type u} [Uncountable α] :
  ¬(Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.zeroSingletons α).Countable ∧
    (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.zeroSingletons α).Pairwise
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.Compatible ∧
      (¬∃ r,
            ∀ p ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.zeroSingletons α,
              Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.Extends r p) ∧
        ⋃ p ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.zeroSingletons α, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.graph p =
          Set.range fun x => (x, false)
